name: El Encanto
insider_take: This Spanish Colonial Revival masterpiece perched on the Santa Barbara Riviera has been the American Riviera's most romantic hideaway since 1918, where old Hollywood glamour meets modern luxury.
whats_special: El Encanto sits on 7 acres of lush gardens with stunning Pacific Ocean views, featuring individual craftsman-style bungalows connected by winding garden paths. The property was once a favorite retreat of stars like Clark Gable and Carole Lombard, and maintains its timeless elegance with handcrafted tiles, wrought-iron details, and California mission-style architecture.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at The Dining Room's terrace - the panoramic views of the Channel Islands and Pacific coastline are absolutely magical during golden hour.
dont_miss: The zero-edge infinity pool that appears to spill into the ocean below, and a stroll through the property's orange groves and jasmine-scented gardens. The nearby Santa Barbara Mission (founded in 1786) is just minutes away, earning the city its nickname "Queen of the Missions."
pros: Stunning hilltop setting with sweeping views of Santa Barbara and the Pacific Ocean
Beautifully restored historic Craftsman bungalows blending charm with modern luxury
Exceptional outdoor dining experience surrounded by lush, manicured gardens
World-class spa offering rejuvenating treatments in a serene, secluded atmosphere
Belmond Bellini Club perks including exclusive benefits, upgrades, and personalized service
cons: Hillside location may require walking on uneven terrain, less ideal for guests with mobility concerns
Secluded setting means limited walkability to downtown Santa Barbara attractions
Premium luxury pricing reflects the Belmond brand and may not suit all budgets
